# ssp_alarm_state (Resource)

Acknowledges or suppresses a pre-existing alarm instance by ID.

Alarm instances are generated by the platform, not by this resource — there is no
`POST`/`DELETE` to create or remove one. Use `id` to adopt an existing instance
(see `data.ssp_alarms` to discover valid IDs).

`desired_state` accepts only the two real transition actions the API supports —
`ACKNOWLEDGE` or `SUPPRESS` — which is a narrower set than the `state` values an
alarm instance can report (`OPEN`, `ACKNOWLEDGED`, `SUPPRESSED`, `RESOLVED`); an
alarm transitions to `RESOLVED`/`OPEN` on its own once its underlying condition
changes, not via this API.

`Delete()` only removes this resource from Terraform state — there is no remote
call to undo an acknowledgement/suppression.

Corresponds to `POST /ssp/alarms/states` and `GET /ssp/alarms/{id}`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `desired_state` (String) Transition action to apply to the alarm instance. Real API enum (`UpdatedState`): `ACKNOWLEDGE` or `SUPPRESS`.
- `id` (String) ID of the pre-existing alarm instance to acknowledge or suppress.

### Optional

- `suppress_duration` (Number) Hours to suppress the alarm for, when `desired_state = "SUPPRESS"` (0-12, defaults to 1 server-side if unset). Ignored for `ACKNOWLEDGE`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Full description of this alarm instance.
- `feature_name` (String) Feature this alarm instance is associated with.
- `recommended_action` (String) Guidance on how to address this alarm instance.
- `resource_id` (String) Identifier of the resource this alarm instance was raised for.
- `severity` (String) Severity level of this alarm instance.
- `state` (String) Actual current state of the alarm instance, as reported by the API.
- `summary` (String) Brief overview of this alarm instance.
- `value` (String) Current reported value associated with the alarm.
